newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Beijing vows won't meddle in HK affairs - paper.
newsitem.headline: Beijing vows won't meddle in HK affairs - paper.

text.p: Chinese President Jiang Zemin pledged Beijing would not intefere in Hong Kong affairs after Britain hands the colony back China, a Beijing-backed newspaper reported on Friday.
The Ta Kung Pao quoted Jiang as telling a Hong Kong business delegation in Beijing that Hong Kong would be governed autonomously under the Basic Law, the territory's Beijing-drawn mini-constitution.
Beijing has promised that Hong Kong can retain its capitalist system after its return to communist China at midnight on June 30 for 50 years without change.
The principles of "one country, two systems", "Hong Kong people ruling Hong Kong" and "a high degree of autonomy" were Beijing's long-term policy on the territory, Jiang was quoted as saying.
